title: Land and Expand: How Growth Continues
message: The first enterprise win is the beginning of the customer relationship, not the end.

steps.line: Win the first strategic account — right-sized, high-trust, referenceable.
Deliver the first deployment to a visible, measurable standard.
Make the business case real — outcomes the customer's own leadership can verify.
Grow across divisions, geographies and use cases, from proven value.
Keep value compounding: continuous reviews, optimisation and renewal.

caption: Land and expand is the account-level motion inside every Build–Operate–Sustain engagement: the first win funds the proof, the proof funds the expansion, and expansion deepens the partnership.
